input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds our preferred position. Vendor warrants performance in a professional and workmanlike manner to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days from the later of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term — better than the 12-month software benchmark (19.2); Vendor warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3); and the remedy is prompt re-performance, repair or replacement, escalating to termination plus refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4). The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. The only mild narrowing is that the malicious-code warranty covers code "intentionally introduced by Vendor," which is market-standard and adequately backstopped by the security obligations in Section 17; no redline warranted.
